findings.summary: Not fixed. README.md still has two blank lines in a row at lines 25-26 (seen with cat -vet; an awk scan reports a double blank at line 26). The file's mtime is still 19:53, which is earlier than review5 (20:07). So the bytes have not changed since review5 flagged it. validation.md has no double blank lines. The claim that Prettier ran --write and then --check with exit 0 is consistent with what is on disk, because .prettierignore line 87 ('work/rounds/*/reports/', commented 'Worker delivery reports are verbatim evidence ... never reformatted') excludes the whole report directory. Prettier skips ignored files and exits 0 without touching them. That exit code does not show the file was formatted. The same ignore rule also invalidates part of the F3 failure scenario in review5: the root format:check would not flag this file. What remains is a spacing defect in a capsule that will be frozen, not a gate failure.

findings.recommendation: Delete one of the blank lines at README.md lines 25-26 by hand; Prettier cannot be used because the path is ignored. Confirm the fix with cat -vet or awk instead of prettier --check. Do not cite the Prettier exit 0 as evidence for files under work/rounds/*/reports/.
